products.name: Azure Monitor & Log Analytics — Foundation, Alerts & Dashboards — Commercial
products.short_description: See what your Azure estate is doing — a Log Analytics foundation with diagnostics at scale, actionable alerts, and workbook dashboards.
products.description:
See what your Azure estate is doing — a Log Analytics foundation with diagnostics at scale, actionable alerts, and workbook dashboards.

Azure resources emit rich telemetry that most teams never collect or act on, so problems surface as outages instead of alerts. This solution builds an Azure Monitor foundation — a designed Log Analytics workspace, diagnostic settings applied at scale via Azure Policy, metric/log alert rules with action groups, and workbook dashboards for ops visibility.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Log Analytics workspace design, retention, and access
  • Diagnostic settings at scale via Azure Policy (resource logs → workspace)
  • Metric and log alert rules with action groups and routing
  • VM insights / container insights enablement
  • Workbooks and dashboards for ops and executive views

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

An observability foundation where problems page you with context — not an inbox full of nothing until the outage.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 3 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OBSAZMON-Discovery.ps1 — inventory the Azure estate and its current monitoring coverage (read-only)
    • OBSAZMON-Report.ps1 — diagnostics coverage + ingestion/cost report (read-only)
    • OBSAZMON-Validate.ps1 — verify the deployed Azure Monitor foundation is healthy (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
